steps.text: Welcome aboard. I am MAGELLAN, the ship AI. I will show you how to carry freight.
This is a contract. Press Accept to take it. Its freight goes to the dock.
Drag each cargo from the dock into the hold, the grid in the middle.
Right click a cargo, or press R, to rotate it. Rotate the Steel Ingot.
The hazard shows each shift step of the next jump. This jump has one step: RIGHT.
In a step, each cargo slides until a wall or a stopped cargo stops it. The force of its hit is its weight × the cells it slid: light 1, standard 2, heavy 3.
The Energy Crystal is Fragile: a hit with a force of 2 or more breaks it. The striped band marks the front wall.
Try it: place the cargo so that the crystal does not break. Then press Warp.

fail.text: The crystal broke. A slide into the wall, or a cargo behind it, hit it with a force of 2 or more. Let us try again.

steps.text: Delivered! Each intact freight pays. A broken cargo becomes scrap and stays in the hold. Press Continue.
This contract has traits. Accept it.
Fragile breaks at a force of 2. Fluid leaks at 2. Volatile explodes at 3. Point at a cargo to see its traits.
A cargo that does not slide still takes a hit. At the front wall, it takes a wall jolt of its weight. It also presses on the cargo in front of it with its weight.
Drag the freight into the hold.
A clamp stops a cargo from sliding. Drag the clamp onto a cargo in the hold.
Try it: deliver each piece. The step is DOWN. Keep the Specimen Tube and the Coolant Pipe away from the floor and from heavy cargo.

fail.text: A piece broke or leaked. Look at the wall jolt and the press, and try again.

steps.text: Good flying. Press Continue.
Space Cheese is Perishable. At the arrival, it must be next to a Cooler, or it spoils. Accept the contract.
Buy the Cooler Unit in the shop. Kit stays in the ship until you sell it.
Each cargo has mass. Over the mass limit, the warp takes a fuel fee. The top bar shows the mass.
Put the freight and the Cooler in the hold. Each cheese must be next to the Cooler.
Try it: the steps are LEFT, then UP. Only the places at the arrival count. Keep the cheese next to the Cooler.

fail.text: A piece did not arrive intact or fresh. Place the cheese and the Cooler where the slides keep them together, and try again.

steps.text: The leg ends. Press Continue.
At the end of each leg, the freight company takes a payment. Pay it. A run has 3 legs.
